svg.title: BSR coverage — dark geography
svg.desc: Italy-wide coverage anchored at Carpi; Milano, Roma and Napoli are representative emphasis points, not an exhaustive service list. Secondary country corridor cues: France, Spain, Portugal, Hungary, Romania, Greece and Türkiye. Schematic corridors are not literal driving directions; dashed segments represent sea connections. Geography: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 countries, public domain. All variants share viewBox 0 0 1800 1000; labels are a separate editable text group.
svg.metadata: Source: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson ; Projection: equirectangular, standard parallel 43 degrees north. Origin Carpi: 10.8788E, 44.7833N.
